title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
SENIOR DATA ENGINEER

£85,000 + BONUS + BENEFITS

LONDON (HYBRID)

Our client is looking for someone to help build a modern cloud data platform that supports their extensive growth plans.

THE COMPANY

A business going through an exciting period of growth, the business uses data and technology to optimise pharmaceutical sourcing and supply chains.

THE ROLE

  • Build and enhance scalable data pipelines using Snowflake, dbt, Airflow and Python.
  • Improve platform reliability, testing, monitoring and CI/CD processes.
  • Partner with Analytics, Data Science and Engineering teams to deliver data solutions.
  • Engage with stakeholders to understand requirements and drive business value.

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 4+ years' experience in Data Engineering with Strong SQL and Python skills
  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt and Airflow (or similar tools)
  • Exposure to CI/CD, automated testing and cloud data platforms
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Databricks/PySpark experience would be advantageous

SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • £85K base salary
  • Annual bonus
  • Pension Contribution
  • Private healthcare
  • Additional employee benefits

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your CV to Ross McEwan through the Apply link.
